integrity: The classification is proved symbolically by exhausting all multiplicative partitions with total prime-factor multiplicity at most three. The finite checker is regression evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to integers with \(\Omega(n)\le3\). It does not classify higher multiplicity and does not address infinitude of primes represented by \(p^2\pm p+1\).
title: Divisibility by the small-divisor sum through \(\Omega(n)\le3\)
